note: V7 retracts V6 with honest hashes. Changes from V6: (a) C3 dropped — scripts/purge_legacy_schemas.sh never existed in git history; Action 3 was carried out manually so the planned automation artifact was unnecessary. (b) C11 dropped — its attestation (specific deleted-file sentinel) is redundant with C12 (whole directory absence) and used an out-of-schema `FILE_ABSENT` sentinel for expected_sha256 (schema allows only DIRECTORY_* sentinels). (c) C5/C6/C7/C10 hashes refreshed — V6 froze a snapshot that drifted under normal development; refreshed hashes reflect current canonical state; statements unchanged. (d) C12 flipped from FAIL to PASS — legacy root schemas/ directory is now DIRECTORY_ABSENT, satisfying the seam's blocking condition. (e) V4/V5/V6 receipts remain in CLOSURES/ as historical record but are RETRACTED by chain (V6 retracts V5, V7 retracts V6). Ghost detector should now pass V7; V4/V5/V6 will continue failing the detector by design — they are retracted artifacts of the closure process, preserved for audit, not for current truth. Followup: teach ghost detector to skip claims in receipts that have been retracted by a later receipt's `retracts` chain.
